description: Premium Intelligence products to publish through POST /api/v1/premium-intelligence?action=publish-certified (scripts/publish-premium-reports.js). Every entry must point at a ReportX export plus a CYBERDUDEBIVASH internal APPROVE review record whose artifact_sha256 equals the export's rendered_text. The production certifier (api/_lib/premium-report-certification.js) re-checks this server-side; no entry is sellable without it. Prices are operator decisions (2026-10-01: INR 1,999 each). Schema 2 (2026-10-01): products are versioned. Each v2 entry names the v1 product it supersedes; scripts/publish-premium-reports.js publishes v2 (R2 write + verify, then catalog row), confirms it live, and only then retires v1. A versioned entry is publishable only after the authorized CDB internal authority writes its REVIEW-RECORD with `cli.py reportx-review approve` (docs/quality/PREMIUM-REPORT-HUMAN-REVIEW.md).

products.title: Sentinel APEX Ransomware Intelligence Report — Qilin Claim Against 'Spoonful of Comfort'
products.summary: CDB-internal reviewed intelligence on Qilin's 2026-08-16 leak-site listing of a US hospitality business, explicitly scoped as a single-source claim. Covers Qilin's RaaS model (Water Galura), its 2023–2025 campaign chronology, the Moonstone Sleet overlap, ATT&CK-mapped TTPs, detection and hunting guidance, alternative hypotheses, regulatory considerations, intelligence gaps and a sourced evidence ledger.

products.title: Sentinel APEX Ransomware Intelligence Report — DragonForce Claim Against 'Vermont XCenter'
products.summary: CDB-internal reviewed intelligence on DragonForce's 2026-08-17 leak-site listing of a Brazil-based contact-center/BPO, explicitly scoped as a single-source claim. Covers DragonForce's LockBit/Conti-derived variants, its 2025 'cartel' evolution, historical CVE exploitation, current tracked scale, ATT&CK-mapped TTPs, detection and hunting guidance, alternative hypotheses, intelligence gaps and a sourced evidence ledger.

products.title: Sentinel APEX Ransomware Intelligence Report — MedusaLocker Claim Against 'Bija Industrie'
products.summary: CDB-internal reviewed intelligence on MedusaLocker's 2026-08-16 leak-site listing of a French aerospace/industrial tooling manufacturer, explicitly scoped as a single-source claim. products.title: Sentinel APEX Vulnerability Intelligence Assessment — CVE-2025-62593 (Ray)
products.summary: Refreshed 2026-10-01. The browser-reachable RCE in Ray before 2.52.0 (CISA KEV, flagged for forensic triage) and why the risk has changed: EPSS now 0.62 (99th percentile), CISA rates exploitation automatable. Two exposure paths, including why patching alone leaves network-reachable dashboards open; three Sigma rules built from the vendor fix; 57 dated indicators (RondoDox, ShadowRay 2.0); hunting steps, prioritised remediation and a sourced evidence ledger.
